business_summary: Avidbank Holdings, Inc. operates as a bank holding company for Avidbank that provides financial solutions and services. It offers business and personal deposit products, such as checking, money market, and savings accounts; and certificates of deposit. The company also provides lending products, including working capital lines of credit, equipment loans, acquisition financing, shareholder buyouts, ESOP loans, and owner-occupied real estate loans; sponsor finance comprising acquisition term loans, recapitalization term loans, and working capital lines; and venture lending, such as venture debt, growth capital, recurring revenue, and treasury management services. In addition, it offers commercial real estate lending consisting of permanent loans and bridge financing products; Asset-Based Lending that includes Borrowing Base and ABL term loans; and construction lending products, including land acquisition loans, construction spec SFD, owner-occupied SFD, condominiums, subdivision, unsecured business lines, pre-development loans, real estate bridge loans, and RLOC  real estate secured loans. Further, the company provides private equity and venture capital financing solutions; structure finance; security and fraud prevention services; domestic and international wires, ACH origination, corporate credit cards, bill pay, trade finance letters of credit, and zero balance account; remote deposit capture, ACH collections, incoming wires, lockbox, and merchant services; and online banking real time fraud mitigation tools, check positive pay, and ACH positive pay. Additionally, it offers ATM/debit cards, credit cards, business courier, and complimentary notary services, as well as online and mobile banking services. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
business_summary_ko: Avidbank Holdings, Inc.는 금융 솔루션 및 서비스를 제공하는 Avidbank의 은행 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 당좌예금, 머니마켓, 저축계좌 등 기업 및 개인 예금 상품을 제공합니다. 및 예금 증서. 이 회사는 또한 운전 자본 신용 한도, 장비 대출, 인수 금융, 주주 매수, ESOP 대출 및 소유자 점유 부동산 대출을 포함한 대출 상품을 제공합니다. 인수 기간 대출, 자본 확충 기간 대출, 운전 자본 라인으로 구성된 후원 금융; 벤처 대출, 성장 자본, 반복 수익 및 재무 관리 서비스와 같은 벤처 대출. 또한 영구 대출과 브리지 파이낸싱 상품으로 구성된 상업용 부동산 대출도 제공합니다. 차용 기반 및 ABL 기간 대출을 포함하는 자산 기반 대출; 토지 취득 대출, 건설 사양 SFD, 자가 점유 SFD, 콘도미니엄, 분할, 무담보 사업 라인, 개발 전 대출, 부동산 브릿지 대출 및 RLOC(부동산 담보 대출)을 포함한 건설 대출 상품. 또한 회사는 사모 펀드 및 벤처 캐피탈 금융 솔루션을 제공합니다. 구조
